Usage of AI to generate code has been documented and made transparent.
I understand that AI cannot be an author and the commit messages do not contain any chatbots or agents as "co-authors".
- [ ] I hereby confirm that I wrote this PR description myself and that I did not use an LLM to draft this description.

open_signals.sentence: You can get help from the community, and discuss any changes before you start implementing them.

ai_hits.sentence: You can use any tools that help you understand the Zulip codebase and write good code, including AI tools.
**Do not submit an AI-generated PR you haven't personally understood and tested**, as this wastes maintainers' time.
### Using AI as a coding assistant
Split up your changes into **[coherent commits][commit discipline]**, even if an LLM generates them all in one go.
If using an LLM to generate comments, be really specific in your request, demand succinctness, and carefully edit the result.
Clear and concise communication, focused on points that actually require discussion, are strongly preferred over long AI-generated comments.
Zulip's contributors are expected to communicate with intention to avoid wasting maintainer time with long, machine-generated or sloppy writing.
**Do not post AI-generated messages** in the [Zulip development community](https://zulip.com/development-community/) -- we want to read your own genuine expression of your thoughts.
A good rule of thumb for any LLM output that you generate is if you can't make yourself **carefully** read it, nobody else wants to read it either.

If you use an LLM to write a pull request description or comment, it is **your responsibility** to read through the whole thing, make sure that it makes sense to you, and represents your ideas concisely.
LLM-generated content based on your code changes will be an unnecessary regurgitation of information that's already there.
Absolutely do not copy and paste LLM-generated responses to review feedback into a PR thread.
Verify that **everything you write is accurate**, whether or not an LLM generated any part of it.
It's not an efficient use of anyone's time to answer general questions like "How do I do this issue?" or to read and respond to an LLM-generated pull request plan.
- [ ] Followed the [AI use policy](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/contributing.html#ai-use-policy-and-guidelines).
